motivation: After three failed price-only cohorts, distinguish volume-conditioned temporary selling pressure from continuation; do not tune a trading strategy to these cells
data: Frozen spot1H OHLCV2020-2026 snapshot;4H aggregate from1H, no native4H source substitution
shock: Completed4H logreturn<=-1.5*sample stdev of preceding30returns excluding event; volatility floor1e-4; currentvolume>0
seasonal_volume: Median of8 previous observations exactly42 four-hour bars apart (same weekday and UTC4H slot), exclude current/future
spacing: Keep chronological first eligible shock, suppress following events until72h from previous event signal; no future-dependent thinning
execution: Signal end+1hour hourly open entry, scheduled hourly open exit24/72h later; missing/zero-volume execution label unavailable rather than fill; no actual orders
primary_comparison: High-volume minus normal-volume mean net24h return; descriptive/confounded, not causal identification or alpha
uncertainty: Joint circular calendar-day block bootstrap, blocks14/30d,2000reps,seed20261021; resample date sums/counts identically across6cells, retain non-event days; pointwise5/95 bands and simultaneous max-standardized-deviation95 bands reported as exploratory
selection: No threshold/horizon/bin reselection. All6cells, costs, subperiods, invalid/missing labels and primarydifference retained, no trading candidate promotion
stop_policy: No count as qualified strategy; future candidate requires separate preregistration and genuinely unknown data
